```python
import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    for c in ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
              "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    units_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    units_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    ord_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    ord_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)

    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "TW",
                  "value": num(rev_tw), "formula": "sum(Revenue_TW)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "LW",
                  "value": num(rev_lw), "formula": "sum(Revenue_LW)"})
    if rev_lw > 0:
        facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": num((rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100, 1),
                      "formula": "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100"})

    ly_mask = df["Revenue_LY"].notna()
    if ly_mask.any():
        rev_ly = df.loc[ly_mask, "Revenue_LY"].sum()
        rev_tw_ly = df.loc[ly_mask, "Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
        facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "LY",
                      "value": num(rev_ly), "formula": "sum(Revenue_LY) over rows with LY data"})
        if rev_ly > 0:
            facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "YoY",
                          "value": num((rev_tw_ly - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100, 1),
                          "formula": "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100 over rows with LY data"})

    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "units", "period": "TW",
                  "value": num(units_tw), "formula": "sum(Units_TW)"})
    if units_lw > 0:
        facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "units", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": num((units_tw - units_lw) / units_lw * 100, 1),
                      "formula": "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "orders", "period": "TW",
                  "value": num(ord_tw), "formula": "sum(Orders_TW)"})
    if ord_lw > 0:
        facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "orders", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": num((ord_tw - ord_lw) / ord_lw * 100, 1),
                      "formula": "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100"})

    # Top 5 entities by this week's revenue
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, r in top.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": str(r["Entity"]), "metric": "revenue", "period": "TW",
                      "value": num(r["Revenue_TW"]), "formula": "Revenue_TW for the entity"})
    if len(top) > 0:
        lead = top.iloc[0]
        sh = lead["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(lead.get("Share_Pct")) else (
            lead["Revenue_TW"] / rev_tw * 100 if rev_tw else np.nan)
        if pd.notna(sh):
            facts.append({"entity": str(lead["Entity"]), "metric": "share", "period": "TW",
                          "value": num(sh, 1), "formula": "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100"})
        facts.append({"entity": str(lead["Entity"]), "metric": "rank", "period": "TW",
                      "value": num(lead["Rank"], 0) if pd.notna(lead["Rank"]) else 1.0,
                      "formula": "Rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)"})

    if rev_tw > 0:
        top5_share = top["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100
        facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "share", "period": "TW",
                      "value": num(top5_share, 1),
                      "formula": "sum(Revenue_TW of top 5 entities) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100"})

    # Biggest absolute WoW revenue movers
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["abs_wow"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).head(3).iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": str(r["Entity"]), "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": num(r["abs_wow"]), "formula": "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW"})
    for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow").head(3).iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": str(r["Entity"]), "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": num(r["abs_wow"]), "formula": "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW"})

    # Biggest percentage WoW movers among meaningful entities
    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct", "Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"])
    p = p[(p["Revenue_LW"] >= 100) | (p["Revenue_TW"] >= 100)]
    for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": str(r["Entity"]), "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": num(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})
    for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct").head(2).iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": str(r["Entity"]), "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": num(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})

    # YoY movers
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct", "Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"])
    y = y[(y["Revenue_LY"] >= 100) | (y["Revenue_TW"] >= 100)]
    for _, r in y.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": str(r["Entity"]), "metric": "revenue", "period": "YoY",
                      "value": num(r["YoY_Pct"], 1),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})
    for _, r in y.sort_values("YoY_Pct").head(2).iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": str(r["Entity"]), "metric": "revenue", "period": "YoY",
                      "value": num(r["YoY_Pct"], 1),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})

    # Top entity by units and by orders
    u = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"])
    if len(u):
        r = u.sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        facts.append({"entity": str(r["Entity"]), "metric": "units", "period": "TW",
                      "value": num(r["Units_TW"]), "formula": "max(Units_TW)"})
    o = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"])
    if len(o):
        r = o.sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        facts.append({"entity": str(r["Entity"]), "metric": "orders", "period": "TW",
                      "value": num(r["Orders_TW"]), "formula": "max(Orders_TW)"})

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
